# Set it up {.divider background-color="#CC0000"}

[15 minutes, together]{.eyebrow}

## Install

::: {.cards .two}
::: {.card}
[Mac]{.card-title}

Open **Terminal**: <kbd>⌘</kbd> <kbd>Space</kbd>, type "Terminal"

<div class="type shell">curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash</div>
:::

::: {.card}
[Windows]{.card-title}

Open **PowerShell**: Start, type "PowerShell"

<div class="type shell">irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex</div>
:::
:::

**No progress bar.** It's working; give it a minute. When it's done, read the end for **Setup notes** (next slide),
then **open a new terminal window.**

## Check, then sign in

::: {.two-col .even}
::: {}
<div class="type shell">claude &#45;&#45;version</div>

A version number, like `2.1.299 (Claude Code)`

<div class="type shell">claude</div>

Pick a text style, sign in through the browser, come back. Asked to trust your home folder? **No, exit**: you're
signed in.
:::

::: {}
| If you see | Do |
|---|---|
| `command not found` or `not recognized` | Run the fix under **Setup notes** in the install output, then open a **new** terminal |
| Your plan doesn't include Claude Code | Free plan: pair up today |
| Mac offers "command line developer tools" | **Not Now** is fine |
:::
:::

::: {.muted style="margin-top:14px"}
Mac PATH fix: `echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.zshrc && source ~/.zshrc`. Windows: see the
Setup page.
:::

## A 60-second tour

- **The prompt box**: say what you want, in plain words
- **The mode line** below it: `⏵⏵ auto mode on`
- `/` lists commands; `/help` explains them
- <kbd>Esc</kbd> stops Claude mid-step; <kbd>Esc</kbd> <kbd>Esc</kbd> goes back in time
- <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> changes how much it asks before acting

::: {.muted style="margin-top:24px"}
New to terminals? Anthropic's *terminal guide for new users* is linked from the Setup page. Rather not use one? The
Claude desktop app has a **Code** tab that runs the same agent.
:::
